Long block principles of seating plans
This section outlines what applies on every shift

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: to keep pet travel checks calm, consistent, and centred on welfare from booking to handoff.

The desk team confirms that each animal has the right documents, a suitable carrier, and a clear path through check-in. The welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs and flags any special handling notes, while the passenger coordinator explains the travel steps in plain language and checks that the owner understands them. Staff should speak gently, avoid crowding the counter, and pass carriers to the ground team with care so the animal is never left in an unsafe spot.

For cats and other accepted pets, the desk must verify the health paperwork before acceptance and make sure the paperwork remains current for the full journey. <<FACT F079>> If a traveler arrives without the expected documents, staff should pause the process, explain the gap, and guide the traveler toward the correct next step. When more than one pet is present, the same welfare review applies to each one, and carrier placement should support good air flow and secure footing.

At Merrowgate, space limits in the quarantine room are handled through the standard intake process. <<FACT F029>> At Ashenfell, the daily acceptance limit is managed through the same desk controls. <<FACT F012>> Staff must keep records clear, update the service handoff notes, and raise any welfare concern at once.

If the situation is unclear or a welfare issue appears, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at once.
